description: This Java class demonstrates how to implement bitmap printing in an Android application. It displays an image and provides a menu option to print that image using Android's print framework and support libraries.

classes.name: PrintBitmap
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates how to print a bitmap image using Android's print framework, offering a menu option to initiate printing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and binds the ImageView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource to add print option in the overflow menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections; initiates printing when the print menu item is selected.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Handles the process of printing the image using PrintHelper.
